Title: FF_PTS_001 — Orders: PTS Packaging ID available in Table View
Section: Fulfillment Console > BSD-29441 > Orders > PTS Packaging ID
Preconditions: PROD Fulfillment Console; Demand system = PTS
Steps:
1. Log in to Fulfillment Console
2. Confirm Orders tab is active
3. Left filter → Demand system → PTS
4. Open Table View (Manage columns)
5. Search or scroll for PTS Packaging ID
Expected Result: PTS Packaging ID appears in the Orders Table View column list (field key ptsPackagingId)
